Action: Open OpenELIS at https://mgtest.openelis-global.org and log in as admin. Open Postman with the OpenELIS mgtest QC collection imported. Run Folder 6 → "POST seed WHO AFRO HIV-VL Cycle 2026-Q2" once (skip if already seeded — it returns 409 the second time).
Expected Result: Postman returns 200/201 (or 409 on a re-run). The OpenELIS side menu shows an EQA section with sub-items: Management, Distribution, My Programs, Orders, Results, Participants.

Action: In OpenELIS, click EQA → My Programs in the side navigation.
Expected Result: The "WHO AFRO HIV-VL Cycle 2026-Q2" program is listed, with provider WHO AFRO. (This is the verification program registry — the user can identify their EQA / verification programs.)

Action: Click Order → Add Order. On the Test Request page, check the EQA Sample checkbox.
Expected Result: A notification appears: "EQA Sample — Patient Info Locked — Patient demographic fields are automatically set for EQA samples and cannot be edited." The Patient ID, Last Name, First Name fields all show NULL and are not editable. (This is correct — EQA samples should not contain real patient data.)

Action: Click the Programme dropdown on the EQA Sample form.
Expected Result: The dropdown shows "WHO AFRO HIV-VL Cycle 2026-Q2" (the program seeded in step 0). Select it. Additional fields appear: Provider Sample ID, Result Deadline, Participant ID, EQA Priority (defaults to Standard).

Action: Fill in the EQA fields: Provider Sample ID = WHO-2026Q2-001, Result Deadline = today + 3 days, Participant ID = MGTEST-001, EQA Priority = Standard. Add an HIV-VL test to the sample. Click Save.
Expected Result: The order is created. A confirmation appears with the lab number assigned. The sample is flagged as an EQA sample in the system.

Action: Wait about 5 minutes (the deadline-alert scheduler runs on a 5-minute interval). Then check Alerts in the side nav (or the Alerts dashboard).
Expected Result: A deadline alert appears for your EQA sample with type "EQA Deadline". The severity (Info / Warning / Critical) depends on how many hours are left until the deadline you set in step 4. (This confirms the system can notify users about EQA deadlines.)
